blocks.text: Computer network jure hue computers aur devices ka group hai jo data, resources aur services share karte hain.
Network architecture network ka design aur tarteeb hai: devices kaise jure hain aur baat-cheet kaise hoti hai.
Network topology network mein devices aur connections ki tarteeb hai, jaise star, bus, ring, mesh ya tree.
Local Area Network (LAN) chhote ilaqe, jaise ghar, school, daftar ya computer lab, ke andar devices jorta hai.
Wide Area Network (WAN) bare ilaqon, jaise shehron, mulkon ya bar-e-azamon (continents), mein networks jorta hai.
Internet sab se bara public network hai jo poori duniya ke karoron devices aur networks jorta hai.
Networking devices woh hardware hain, jaise switch, router, modem, NIC aur access point, jo devices jorte aur baat-cheet sambhalte hain.
OSI model saat layers ka model hai jo batata hai ke network mein data ek device se doosre tak kaise jata hai.
Network protocol rules (qaidon) ka set hai jo tay karta hai ke devices ke darmiyan data kaise bheja, wusool aur samjha jaye.
IP address device ko diya gaya unique (sirf usi ka) address hai taake network par us ki pehchan ho sake.
Subnetting bare network ko chhote networks mein baantne ka process (amal) hai, taake management (intizam) aur security behtar ho.
Network security woh tareeqe hain jo networks, devices aur data ko unauthorized access (baghair ijazat pohanch), misuse (ghalat istemal) ya hamlon se bachate hain.

items: Networks: qismein (LAN, WAN, Internet), devices, topologies, OSI layers, protocols.
Addressing: IP address aur subnetting; network security se hifazat.
